subject: NPC
text: If an NPC kills an enemy, its experience points are still awarded to you.

evidence.quote: Take note that if a NPC kills an enemy, its experience points will still be added to you.

subject: Heroine
text: Asking the Heroine will cause her to slowly regenerate your HP.

evidence.quote: If you ASK her, she will slowly regenerate your HPs.

subject: Mysterious Man
text: Asking the Mysterious Man will prompt him to teach you how to use the Mattock.

evidence.quote: If you ASK him, he will teach you how to use the item, Mattock

subject: Watts
text: Asking Watts allows you to shop for items.

evidence.quote: If you ASK him, he will let you shop for Items.

subject: Bogard
text: Asking Bogard prompts him to teach you how to use MAX attacks.

evidence.quote: If you ASK him, he will teach you how to use MAX attacks.

subject: Chocobo
text: Asking the Chocobo gives you a ride on its back during which enemies cannot harm you.

evidence.quote: If you ASK the chocobo, it will give you a ride on its back...any enemy cannot harm you.

subject: Amanda
text: Asking Amanda heals you of the Petrify (Ston) condition.

evidence.quote: If you ASK her, he will heal you of Petrify (Ston) condition.

subject: Lester
text: Asking Lester changes the background music.

evidence.quote: If you ASK him, he’ll change the background music (pretty useless)

subject: Marcie
text: Asking Marcie restores your MP to full.

evidence.quote: If you ASK Marcie, your MP will be restored to its full.

subject: Power
text: Increasing the Power rating upon leveling up makes battles with monsters easier.

evidence.quote: Power - This will increase the Power rating of your character...make and battle with monsters easier.

subject: Stamina
text: Leveling up Stamina reduces damage from enemy attacks and provides a big HP boost.

evidence.quote: Stamina - This level up concentrates on your defense...damage from enemy attacks. And you’ll have a big HP boost.

subject: Wisdom
text: Choosing Wisdom when leveling up focuses on magic ratings and increases damage caused by magic attacks to enemies.

evidence.quote: Wisdom - This focuses on the Magic ratings of your characters...Magic attacks to your enemies.

subject: Will
text: Leveling up Will lessens the time required for your Will Bar to fill up.

evidence.quote: Will - Leveling up your Will, lessens the time that your Will Bar fills up.

subject: Sword
text: For the Sword MAX Charge Attack, pressing the A Button and the Directional pad makes your character charge in that direction.

evidence.quote: Charge Attack - Press the A Button + Directional pad...character will charge pointing to the direction depending...on what direction you pushed in the Directional pad.

subject: Sword
text: For the Sword MAX Spin Attack, pressing and holding the A Button spins the sword, and you can move around using the directional pad while spinning.

evidence.quote: Spin Attack - Press and hold the A button. This will make your...character spin his sword. During the spinning of your...character, you can move him around by pressing the...directional pad.

subject: Axe
text: At MAX attack, throwing the Axe in front of you can still chop down trees.

evidence.quote: At MAX, your character will throw the Axe in front of him...the thrown Axe can still chop down trees.

subject: Chain
text: At MAX attack, the Chain becomes longer than usual, enabling you to reach poles you cannot reach during normal attacks.

evidence.quote: At MAX, the chain will be longer than usual. This will enable you to...reach poles which you cannot reach during normal chain attacks.

subject: Spear
text: At MAX attack, the Spear is thrown in the direction pressed on the directional pad.

evidence.quote: At MAX, the Spear will be thrown in the direction your pushed on the...directional pad.

subject: Sickle
text: At MAX attack, the spin area of the Sickle becomes wider while still cutting off herbs.

evidence.quote: At MAX, the area of the spin of the Sickle will become wider...You can still cut off Herbs.

subject: Morning Star
text: At MAX attack, the length of the Morning Star becomes much longer than normal.

evidence.quote: At MAX, the length of the Morning Star will be much more...Longer than normal.

subject: Poison
text: Poison slowly depletes your HP and can be cured by using the item Pure or the Magic Heal.

evidence.quote: Poisoned Status. The HP of your character will slowly deplete. To cure it, use...the item “Pure”, or use the Magic “Heal”.

subject: Moogle
text: In the Moogle condition your DP drops to 0, which can be cured by letting time pass or asking the Chocobo.

evidence.quote: Moogle Condition. Your DP will drop to 0 therefore, even the weakest enemies...will deal quite a big damage to you...There 2 known ways to cure it...First, just let time pass by. Second, ASK your chocobo.

subject: Stone
text: In the Stone condition your character is petrified and cannot move but can still attack in place, cured by the item Soft, the magic Heal, or asking Amanda.

evidence.quote: Stone Condition. Your character will be petrified and cannot move...you can still attack in...place. To cure it, use the item “Soft” or use the magic “Heal”. You can also...ASK Amanda to cure it for you.

subject: Darkness
text: In the Darkness condition your screen becomes dark, which can be cured using the item Eyedrop or the Magic Heal.

evidence.quote: Darkness Condition. During this time, your screen will be dark and you can...barely see the field/room...To cure it, use the item “Eyedrop”, or use the Magic “Heal”.
